Study Materials

Question banks organized by the module titles in your uploaded PDFs.

MODULE 1

Fundamentals & Image Transforms

Image formation, visual perception, sampling and quantization, Fourier transforms, FFT, DCT, and wavelets.

22-page PDFOpen question bank ↗
MODULE 2

Image Enhancement

Gray-level transformations, histogram processing, spatial filtering, sharpening, smoothing, and homomorphic filtering.

15-page PDFOpen question bank ↗
MODULE 3

Image Restoration

Degradation models, inverse and pseudo-inverse filtering, noise models, and Wiener filtering.

13-page PDFOpen question bank ↗

How to use this library

Choose a module, open its PDF, and work through the questions. Your original PDFs are preserved. Modules 4 and 5 do not have uploaded question-bank PDFs yet.
